games_csv.note: Carries spread_line, total_line, the two moneylines and the four price columns. The pinned data dictionary DATASETS.md documents none of them: it stops at stadium/referee fields. No capture time exists in the file, so the snapshot kind cannot be established from the data. Treated as UNDATED and never described as an opening or a closing price.

initial_lines_csv.note: Filename and content both state 'initial'. 2021 season only, one sportsbook (WSGT). Supplies a line but no price for either side.

closing_lines_csv.note: Filename states 'closing'. No timestamp field. Provides per-side odds for 2017-2018 only; spread and total odds are empty for 2006-2016.

rule: One row per game x market x side x snapshot_kind. A snapshot kind is only asserted when the source itself asserts it. No capture time is invented: when the source has no timestamp field the row records an empty captured_utc and capture_time_known=false.
